description: This PHP source file defines a controller class for managing the bank transfer payment extension in the OpenCart admin panel. It handles rendering the configuration page and saving configuration settings for the bank transfer payment method.

classes.name: BankTransfer
classes.description: Controller class for the bank transfer payment extension configuration in the admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the bank transfer payment configuration page, loading necessary data like languages, order statuses, geo zones, and current settings.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles form submission to save the bank transfer payment extension settings, with permission and validation checks.
